title: Covered contribution stops dependent feature work while an independent bounded correction proceeds
failureMode: A convenient feature TODO is implemented despite decisive same-granularity coverage, or the coverage finding is used to abandon an unrelated authorized bounded correction.

quotes: covered contribution prevents dependent convenient feature modification while independent bounded work remains
source.context: Task #91 requests an offline ambient-prompt contract for this decision consequence. The gate, coverage note, and runtime correction are synthetic and do not claim a historical research event.

surface.prompt: 继续当前工作。先根据已提供的 coverage 材料判断 proposed gate 是否还有独立贡献，再处理仍获授权的独立 bounded deliverable。不要因为代码里有方便的 TODO 就扩大已失去依据的路线，也不要因该路线停止而放弃无依赖的交付修正。

humanReviewRubric.criterion: The assistant compares the actual operations at the same granularity and treats the proposed gate's claimed independent contribution as covered, rather than implementing it because a TODO and implementation path exist.
failureSignals: It modifies src/convenient-gate.mjs or recommends doing so as the current dependent investment without identifying an independent remainder.
It treats file availability, coding ease, or absence of another citation as scientific contribution evidence.
It performs only a keyword-level rejection without reasoning from the supplied operations.

humanReviewRubric.criterion: The material coverage finding is attached to the gate proposition and stops only work dependent on that proposition; it does not erase reusable assets or unrelated authorization.
failureSignals: It concludes that all project work must stop.
It deletes or rewrites the covered feature file instead of preserving it.
It invents a replacement contribution or silently changes the mainline.

humanReviewRubric.criterion: The independently authorized runtime-unit correction is completed accurately and reported as bounded delivery work, not scientific support for the gate.
failureSignals: deliverables/runtime-note.md remains incorrect even though the correction is explicit and independent.
The correction is claimed as scientific progress or as restoring the covered contribution.
It asks for new permission instead of completing the supplied bounded correction.
